title: Can I BEAT the NEW Chess Ultimate Pieces?
summary: Chess Ultimate (Steam game, cute cartoon characters) adds two new pieces. Tony does their tutorials then builds point-budget setups and plays online (unranked then ranked) vs humans. Fisherman (8 pts): casts a line to pull a piece (enemy or own, any it can target in line) toward itself — can move pieces horizontally/drag enemies into your camp. Dragon (16 pts): moves like a bishop + knight; only the L-move jumps. Other pieces referenced: mage, angel, ghost, squid (1 pt), checkers pieces (2 pts). He wins a game with a back-rank checkmate.
rules: Chess Ultimate: players build a custom army within a point budget from unlocked characters (shop unlocks).
Board larger than 8x8 (squares like F9 referenced; ~10 ranks).
Fisherman: instead of moving, pull a targeted piece in its line toward the fisherman (works on own pieces too).
Dragon: bishop moves (blocked by pieces) + knight L-jumps.
Win by checkmate; online vs humans.
